svg.aria-label: What MindNest does. Routine support: Daily schedule, appointments, reminders and medication reminders. Object finding: Detects and tracks objects, and reports where an item was last seen. Familiar faces: Recognises the people a caregiver has registered. Conversation memory: Speech-to-text, embeddings and RAG recall past conversations in context. Personal assistant: Answers using the patient's schedule, data and retrieved memories. Safety: GPS geofencing with alerts to the caregiver. Well-being: Relaxation, meditation and therapeutic audio. Caregiver dashboard: Patient management, monitoring, notifications and activity logs.

text.tspan: and reports where an item was
